scope: Replace frontend native confirm/prompt dialogs with the shared application Modal.
Cover update installation, backup restore, sync replacement, inventory deletion, unsaved settings, chat clearing, maintenance undo and review-date input.
Reuse application colors, typography and buttons; compact content height, explicit initial focus, Escape cancellation and focus restoration.

browserScenarios.execution: Initial related suites plus corrected focused reruns; not a single uninterrupted full-suite pass.
browserScenarios.corrections: Updated chat test sequencing for asynchronous dialogs; explicit focus after showModal; fit-content sizing. A parallel Playwright output-directory collision was rerun serially.
browserScenarios.updateConfirmation: No browser native dialog; Cancel initially focused; height below 300px; Escape closes confirmation while settings stays open; focus returns; install command is not invoked.
browserScenarios.reviewDate: Input initially focused; cancellation invokes no mutation; confirmed input invokes the fixture command.

checks.sourceAudit: No remaining frontend window.confirm, window.prompt or window.alert calls.
checks.visualReview: Reviewed compact update confirmation screenshot after correcting excessive height.
checks.packaging: Final rebuild generated version 2.3.7 EXE, NSIS installer, updater signature and manifest; artifact timestamps follow the final frontend build.

limits: Browser validation uses isolated bridge fixtures, not an installed native update acceptance.
No personal kitchen, sync queue or chat accessed; no real installation or restart performed.
System file selection and the Windows installer retain their native platform UI.
Local delivery only; not committed, pushed or published.
